title: eriogonum strictum var. anserinum
intro: Eriogonum strictum var. anserinum, commonly known as the Nevada Buckwheat or Buckwheat Sage, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Nevada Buckwheat include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe coughs and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
